## Claim protocol — EXCLUSIVE, ENFORCED (read before you start)

This issue is single-owner. Before touching ANY file, post the first comment:

```
CLAIM <agent-id> <provider> <UTC ISO-8601 timestamp>
```

Then RE-READ the comments. The FIRST valid CLAIM wins. If yours is not first,
you MUST comment `RELEASE <agent-id> conflict` and stop — do not work the issue.
One agent holds one issue at a time in this repository, on ANY provider or
harness (opencode key 1, key 2, zcode). A second agent working a claimed issue
is a protocol violation; its commits may be reverted.

A claim older than 48 h with no `DONE` comment is stale; the first `STALE`
comment releases it. Finish after pushing (Rule 3) with:

```
DONE <remote-sha> <one-line result>
```

## Harness partition (primary guard)

| harness | owns `area:` labels |
|---|---|
| opencode key 1 (`100milionseek`) | `firmware`, `historic` |
| opencode key 2 (`100milionseek-2`) | `soc`, `upstream` |
| zcode | `docs`, `site`, `blobs`, `repo`, `tools` |

Work only your own labels. The CLAIM comment is the secondary guard.

## Discipline

- RULE 0: search web + GitHub code FIRST; record exact queries and dates.
  Prior art found means find the delta, not rebuild.
- RULE 1: fix stale counts, dangling links, broken references in the same
  session, respecting file walls; list before/after.
- Facts-not-blobs: never commit a proprietary payload. Hashes, sizes, offsets,
  counts and <=16-byte hex samples only.
- CLEAN-ROOM: implementation agents write code ONLY from the lab's published
  spec documents and public GPL sources. Never read proprietary code, headers
  or strings. Every implementation file carries a clean-room statement header.
- stdlib-only Python with `python3 -I`, no comments in code.
- Every claim verified by command output before it is written.
- Honest negatives are deliverables. Report them; do not omit them.
- Push when done (Rule 3); never force-push; never push `main` from a worker.

## Task
Produce evidence-classed, reproducible specs for the proprietary blob containers the lab has measured: PIL/.mdt + .bNN, QSEE/TA, QCA .tlv patch + NVM, bdwlan IE chains, Hexagon fastrpc modules, and dsp.img.

## Deliverable
One spec note per format under `research/fleet/` with byte-level layouts, hash/signature rules and a stdlib parser under `implementations/` derived only from published facts and public GPL sources.

## Acceptance
- Every layout identity verified by command output across >=2 files.
- Clean-room statement headers on code; no payload bytes committed.
- RULE 0 searches with dates.
- Push when done (Rule 3).
title: Write clean-room specs for proprietary blob container formats
